event_summary: A night-sky firework display shows bright radial streaks, colored smoke, and later overlapping bursts that appear, expand, and dim.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a large overexposed white-yellow luminous mass in the upper center against a dark sky. As the glare reduces, a circular pattern of white and green radial streaks becomes visible around a central orange-red area, with diffuse smoke spreading through the burst. Red arcs then become prominent across much of the pattern while some green-white arcs remain. A narrow pink-white vertical luminous trail is visible from the bottom center toward the central burst area. Later, a smaller bright yellow-white flare appears lower in the central area and develops short white radial streaks within red and green smoke. The outer red and green streaks gradually dim while smoke remains visible.

reasons: The first frame already contains a large bright overexposed luminous firework area.
The central brightness obscures finer details of the streaks and smoke.
The scene is a dark sky with no visible ground or launch setup.
